issue.title: Navigation drawer does not close when clicking overlay backdrop on mobile viewport
issue.body:
### Description
When opening the mobile drawer menu at viewport 375x667 and clicking the blurred backdrop overlay, the drawer stays open and blocks user interactions.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open application at /dashboard on mobile viewport.
2. Click hamburger menu icon to open sidebar drawer.
3. Click backdrop outside drawer.

### Expected Behavior
Drawer closes with slide-out animation and overlay opacity returns to 0.

### Actual Behavior
Drawer remains open; clicks on the backdrop do not trigger onClick event handler.
